name: voicenotes-local
title: Voicenotes Local
description: Control the official Voicenotes Mac recorder and search your notes.
author: parzival

preferences.name: token
preferences.title: Voicenotes API Token
preferences.description: Your Voicenotes API Token from Settings > Integrations > Obsidian

commands.name: start-recording
commands.title: Start Recording
commands.description: Start Voicenotes capture, or leave an active recording running

commands.name: stop-recording
commands.title: Stop and Save Recording
commands.description: Stop capture and let Voicenotes save and process it

commands.name: cancel-recording
commands.title: Cancel Recording
commands.description: Cancel only the current Voicenotes capture

commands.name: recording-status
commands.title: Recording Setup and Status
commands.description: Check app compatibility, recording state and Accessibility access

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the "prepublishOnly" script and rerun "npm publish" again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use "npm run publish" instead.

" && exit 1
